storage: Keep unpeeled in a paper bag in the fridge for 2 to 3 weeks; peeled or grated ginger can be frozen in small portions.
looksLike: A knobbly, beige-skinned underground stem with pale yellow flesh and a sharp, warm, citrusy smell.
howToPick: Firm, plump, heavy roots with thin taut skin and a sharp smell. Avoid shrivelled, soft, mouldy or sprouting pieces.
shelfLife: About 2 to 3 weeks in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
